welcome.title: Welcome to Sales Forecast Web! 👋
welcome.content: This quick guide will walk you through the main features of the system. It takes less than 2 minutes.

cycle.title: Current Cycle
cycle.content: Use the arrows to navigate between monthly cycles. The active cycle is where you fill in your sales volumes.

kpiBar.title: Unit Indicators
kpiBar.content: Track your progress: confirmed FCST volumes, Budget target, product families, and percentage of filled SKUs.

products.title: Product Portfolio
products.content: Products are grouped by family. Click a family to expand it and edit monthly volumes individually.

submit.title: Submit Forecast
submit.content: Once all volumes are filled in, submit for PPC approval. The system will show a summary before confirming.

consolidadoWindow.title: Analysis Window
consolidadoWindow.content: Use the presets (3M, 6M, 12M) or the arrows to define the historical analysis period.

consolidadoKpis.title: Performance Indicators
consolidadoKpis.content: Forecast Bias, FCST/Budget attainment, realized sales, and accuracy for the period — all in one panel.

consolidadoTabs.title: Division Analysis
consolidadoTabs.content: The Division tab shows the breakdown by product family. The Chronics tab lists products with recurring deviations.

help.title: Help Center 💡
help.content: All set! Whenever you have questions, click the help icon (?) at the top of the screen. There you'll find step-by-step guides, the glossary, training videos and the full manual.

welcome.title: Welcome to Sales Forecast Web! 👋
welcome.content: This quick guide will show you the main monitoring features of the system. It takes less than 2 minutes.

dashboardKpis.title: Control Panel
dashboardKpis.content: Monitor cycle progress: how many units have submitted, pending approvals, and global accuracy.

aprovacoesList.title: Pending Approvals
aprovacoesList.content: Here are all forecast submissions awaiting approval. Review the volumes before approving or rejecting.

aprovacoesFilter.title: Approval Filters
aprovacoesFilter.content: Filter by reference month, sales unit, or status to quickly locate items requiring attention.

consolidadoWindow.title: Analysis Window
consolidadoWindow.content: Set the analysis period using presets (3M, 6M, 12M) or select months manually with the arrows.

consolidadoKpis.title: Consolidated Indicators
consolidadoKpis.content: Track Bias, FCST vs Budget, Sales, and forecast Accuracy for all units in the selected period.

consolidadoChart.title: Cycle Evolution
consolidadoChart.content: The chart shows the monthly evolution of Budget, FCST, and Sales to track trends over time.

consolidadoTabs.title: Division Breakdown
consolidadoTabs.content: In the Divisions tab, expand each sales unit to see the detail by product family and country.

help.title: Help Center 💡
help.content: Whenever you need, click the help icon (?) at the top of the screen to open the Help Center — with guides, glossary, videos and the full manual.

done.title: Tour complete! 🎉
done.content: You've explored the main screens. Use the "Guided tour" button in the sidebar at any time to revisit this guide.
